title: jmap-chat-js startPush: an onOpen signal, so callers need not sleep before relying on push
description: mimid's acceptance harness (f391d48) waits a fixed 500 ms after startPush before making changes, since startPush has no 'stream is open' signal; flaky on slow machines. Add onOpen (or a promise) to jmap-chat-js src/lib/push/eventsource.ts, then drop the sleep in tools/acceptance/jmap-chat-js.
